title: GMax OF-77 Tech Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Gmax OF-77 Tech Grey pairs retro roadster charm with modern multi-density cranial protection. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1306g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~97 dB aero profile. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Versatile open face with internal sun visor at an unbeatable price.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Open face design with extended neck coverage; suitable for oval and intermediate head shapes.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.

Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Gmax's Open Face lineup, the GMax OF-77 Tech Grey brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Gmax OF-77 Tech Grey represents Gmax's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~97 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Gmax OF-77 Tech Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
